slides.title: What help is reaching Ethiopians in Kenya?
Who is being hosted
slides.body: UNICEF says Kenyan authorities are leading a response plan for more than 36,600 Ethiopians who fled insecurity in the south. Many live with host families.

slides.title: What UNICEF says it delivered
slides.body: Therapeutic nutrition supplies to a local hospital, four 10,000-litre water tanks, and hygiene kits for about 1,000 households.

slides.title: Who else is helping
slides.body: WFP, IOM and UNHCR have joined the Kenyan government-led response, UN News reports.
